name: monero-nodeboard
description: Combines a monero node and the monero-dashboard project. The local node will be running on port 18081 (this is what you will connect a local wallet to). If you choose to make this a public node, it will start a service listening on port 18089, which you will need to route to the container.

paths.name: Path: /app/blockchain
paths.description: Location where you want the blockchain to go. This WILL be a large file that grows, but is also best to live on a SSD.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: The port for the monero-dashboard interface.

ports.name: Restricted RPC Server
ports.description: Public node port - needs to be routed to from the outside.

variables.name: PUBLIC_NODE
variables.description: Whether or not to expose your node as a public node on the Monero network. You will need to route port 18089 to this container. Values are true or false (lowercase)

variables.name: Ticker
variables.description: Whether or not to show the XMR ticker
